title: Causes for Expressway Viaduct Collapse and Workplace Safety
what_it_is: Causes for Expressway Viaduct Collapse and Workplace Safety

sections.label: Corbels supporting deck slab
sections.summary: Preliminary investigations suggest the corbels, or fork-like structures, supporting the deck slab gave way.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Preliminary investigations suggest that the corbels, or fork-like structures, supporting the deck slab gave way.

sections.label: LTA viaduct construction ratio
sections.summary: For this viaduct's construction, LTA adopted a 70:30 ratio commonly used for projects of this complexity.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: For the construction of this viaduct, LTA adopted a ratio of 70:30, commonly used for projects of this complexity.

sections.label: Bids disqualified for reason
sections.summary: Since then, 16 bids from 10 contractors have been disqualified for this reason.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since then, 16 bids from 10 contractors have been disqualified for this reason.

sections.label: Two successful bids of 69
sections.summary: Of these 69, only two bids were successful.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Of these 69, only two bids were successful.

sections.label: OKP awarded contract
sections.summary: OKP was awarded the contract after emerging with the highest price-quality score amongst the four tenderers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: OKP was awarded the contract after emerging with the highest price-quality score amongst the four tenderers.

sections.label: OKP lowest quality score
sections.summary: Uncertainty over the exact cause and OKP's liabilities was considered in tender evaluation, so OKP scored lowest for quality, including safety performance.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We did not really know what the exact cause was and what OKP's liabilities were.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: This was, in fact, taken into consideration when we evaluated the tender, and, as a result, OKP scored the lowest for quality, which includes safety performance, in the tender submission.

sections.label: TPE-PIE project ratio
sections.summary: For the TPE-PIE project, a 70:30 ratio was considered, similar to other projects of similar complexity and nature.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In this case, for the TPE-PIE project, a 70:30 ratio was considered, similar to other projects of similar complexity and nature.

sections.label: Corbel design accident cause
sections.summary: Preliminary investigation indicates the design of the corbels could have resulted in the accident.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Suffice to say that based on our preliminary investigation, it is the design of the corbels that could have resulted in the accident.

sections.label: LTA projects percentage
sections.summary: In the case of LTA projects, it forms about 25%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In the case of LTA projects, it forms about 25%.

sections.label: LTA Board veto policy
sections.summary: From 15 July 2015, LTA Board can veto bidders for very poor safety performance alone, and has vetoed 16 bids from 10 companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: In fact, from 15 July 2015 onwards, LTA has put in place a new policy where the LTA Board can veto bidders on the basis of very poor safety performance alone.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Since then, I would like to inform the Member that LTA Board has vetoed 16 bids from 10 companies for this very reason.

sections.label: Investigation completion in October
sections.summary: The investigation is likely to be completed sometime in October.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The investigation is likely to be completed sometime in October.

sections.label: OKP 10-year track record
sections.summary: The Senior Minister of State mentioned that prior to the tender award to OKP, they had a good 10-year track record.

sentences.speaker: Mr Seah Kian Peng
sentences.text: The Senior Minister of State mentioned that prior to the award of the tender to OKP, they had a good 10-year track record.

sections.label: PQM guidelines and BCA approval
sections.summary: BCA dictates PQM guidelines; LTA reviews and amends them as needed, but significant changes require BCA approval.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Indeed, the PQM guidelines have been dictated by BCA.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: LTA does review the guidelines and make necessary changes and amendments according to its needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: If we do need to make any significant changes, we will need to get the approval from BCA as well.
